verdict.rationale: Cline ships a full-featured CLI/headless mode (scripting, auto-approve, cron scheduling, ACP integration) that covers much of what the UI does, and docs emphasize scriptable automation for CI/CD. However, there is no documented REST/OpenAPI surface (probe found only 404s for openapi endpoints), and some UI-only features like the Kanban board's diff review/inline comments aren't shown to have CLI equivalents, so full UI/API parity isn't confirmed. missing for 10: a formal API/OpenAPI spec, explicit parity between Kanban UI actions (diff review, inline comments) and CLI/API, independent confirmation of complete feature equivalence.
